queries: WITH name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM name_totals), above_average AS (SELECT nt.name, nt.total_points, b.avg_total FROM name_totals AS nt CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE nt.total_points > b.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above_average) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN above_average AS a ON a.name = r.name) AS average_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(total_points - avg_total) FROM above_average) AS average_excess_points

WITH name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS total_laps, COUNT(res.laps) AS lap_count, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM name_totals), above_average AS (SELECT n.* FROM name_totals AS n CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE n.total_points > o.avg_total) SELECT SUM(a.total_points) AS combined_total_points, SUM(a.total_laps) / SUM(a.lap_count) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(a.total_points - o.avg_total) AS average_excess_points FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o;
